text:
maya.p: heads up  FinLedger can't push PO via GCP marketplace - portal rejects their signed zip with "attachment_checksum_mismatch". they say procurement workflow requires zipped envelope.
trevor.s: sales on the call, customer will delay go-live if PO not accepted today. can we accept a manual upload?
jin.eng: error in logs: `422 {"error":"attachment_checksum_mismatch","exp":"f1e2...","got":"b3c4..."}`. recent unzip lib change (2026-02-18) changed filename normalization -> can alter bytes.
marketplace-bot: deploy note 2026-02-18 libzip-canonicalize change (rev c3f2b1)  relaxed normalization.
olga.ops: ops risk: preserving raw zip bytes increases storage and potential zip-bomb attack surface. need quotas and a scanner.
anil.legal: can't silently accept altered signed artifacts. propose an opt-in raw-ingest path scoped per-tenant with signed waiver + audit trail.
jin.eng: rough: 1 engineer, 24-36h to add header flag `X-RW-Preserve-Original: true` and bypass normalization + add depth/size checks. ops add feature-flag routing ~3h.
zara.sales: will get customer's signed ACK for waiver and tenant scoping now. Trevor - please emphasize timeline.
trevor.s: on it, will paste ACK here when obtained.
marketplace-bot: created MP-9001 "preserve-original-zip-per-tenant-canary" assigned to @jin.eng.
maya.p: thanks all. prioritize this - revenue impact.
zara.sales: customer on call  they will sign waiver if we enable canary. will update in 15m with signed text.
